rows.title: A website, LinkedIn or GitHub typed as just 'https://', 'http://' or 'www.' prints as a blank contact in the PDF, Word, Markdown and the cover letter
rows.summary: Now: contactItems (src/utils/contacts.js) leaves out a contact whose printed value is empty, so a Website, LinkedIn or GitHub holding only a scheme or 'www.' prints no bare icon and no empty slot between separators, and the ATS check and header spacing do not count it, in every template and export. A Display label over such an address still prints.

notes: Base was origin/claude/r4-green at 420f487 when the branch was cut (the task text named 9519ef6b). First dispatch 36634419420 failed only because the unit test imported coverLetterText.js, which uses @/ aliases; the letter check moved to a harness test in f2a8cf5. Run 36634654504 was green: failfirst proves both tests fail without e04e328 and pass with it, and the contact, ATS, Markdown, JSON Resume, knowledge-docs and 31-contact-fields tests pass.
